description: This is a Java source file that defines a command handler class for deleting email campaigns within the Fineract platform. The class implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the EmailCampaignWritePlatformService to perform the deletion operation in a transactional context.

classes.name: DeleteEmailCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service that handles delete commands for email campaigns, executing the delete operation within a transactional context.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command for an email campaign by invoking the delete method of EmailCampaignWritePlatformService with the entity ID from the command.
